{#- The navbar: the sections of the landing page's table of contents, Playground among them. The table of contents names the playground by its full address, the only kind a toctree takes, which the theme marks as a link to another site. Here it becomes `pathto('playground/', 1)`, a link within the site: the documentation of /dev/ opens /dev/playground/, and a release's opens the playground running its wheel. A release built before the playground was in the table of contents (scripts/backfill_site.py) gets it appended instead, so every version's navbar names it. On a narrow screen the theme moves this into the sidebar with the sections. -#} {%- set nav = generate_header_nav_html(n_links_before_dropdown=theme_header_links_before_dropdown, dropdown_text=theme_header_dropdown_text) -%} {%- set written = 'class="nav-link nav-external" href="https://creatoan.github.io/scenet/playground/"' | safe -%} {%- set here = ('class="nav-link nav-internal" href="' ~ pathto('playground/', 1) ~ '"') | safe -%}
